title: Hearty Ice-Bathed Saudi Arabian Rice Pilaf
description: A dense, earthy, lacto-vegetarian-friendly rice pilaf originating from Saudi Arabia, cooked in a single vessel and then shocked in an ice bath.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in the lacquerware bowl over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent.
Add the chopped carrot and sauté for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper. Sauté for 1 minute.
Add the rice and stir to combine with the spices.
Add the red wine and stir to combine with the rice.
Add 2 cups of water to the bowl and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover the bowl with a tight-fitting lid, and simmer for 18 minutes.
Remove the bowl from the heat and let cool slightly.
Transfer the bowl to an ice bath and let cool completely.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
